prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.rs with the public function at module scope.
Required API: pub fn event_deduplication(input: &str) -> Option<String>
Behavior: Parse window;timestamp:key records. Window and timestamps are canonical unsigned decimals in 0..10000000, records are nondecreasing by timestamp, and keys use ASCII [a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*. Keep an event only when that key has no previously kept event within the inclusive window. Return kept timestamp:key records in input order.
Visible example: 5;1:a,3:b,5:a,7:a returns 1:a,3:b,7:a.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: use std::collections::HashMap;fn key(s:&str)->bool{let p:Vec<_>=s.split('-').collect();!s.is_empty()&&s.as_bytes()[0].is_ascii_lowercase()&&p.iter().all(|x|!x.is_empty()&&x.bytes().all(|c|c.is_ascii_lowercase()||c.is_ascii_digit()))}fn num(s:&str)->Option<i64>{let v:i64=s.parse().ok()?;if v<0||v>10000000||v.to_string()!=s{None}else{Some(v)}}pub fn event_deduplication(s:&str)->Option<String>{let p:Vec<_>=s.split(';').collect();if p.len()!=2||p[1].is_empty(){return None}let w=num(p[0])?;let(mut prev,mut last,mut o)=(-1,HashMap::new(),vec![]);for r in p[1].split(','){let(t,k)=r.split_once(':')?;let v=num(t)?;if !key(k)||v<prev{return None}prev=v;if !last.contains_key(k)||v-last[k]>w{last.insert(k,v);o.push(r)}}Some(o.join(","))}
